name.zh: 黑铁严折断一辉对家人的期待
name.en: Itsuki Breaks Ikki's Faith in Family

periods.location: Ikki's confinement room, League Japan Branch basement
periods.summary: Itsuki visits Ikki, briefly raises his hope by recognizing his record, then explains that he never hated Ikki; he simply believes low-ranked people must not exceed their roles. He tells Ikki to abandon knighthood and do nothing.
periods.cause: Itsuki wants to understand and stop Ikki's continued defiance of Kurogane hierarchy.
periods.process: Ikki asks whether winning the Seven Stars Festival would make Itsuki recognize him. Itsuki says Ikki misunderstood: recognition as a son was never the issue. Ikki's success itself is harmful because it encourages lower-ranked people to defy their assigned hierarchy.
periods.outcome: Ikki realizes his father feels neither hatred nor hope toward him, only institutional doctrine, and his emotional foundation collapses.
periods.significance: The decisive psychological wound that helps Akaza's drugs and confinement break Ikki down before the final match.
